results.title: WAPDA signs Rs133 billion accord for Diamer Bhasha Dam HM-1 contract
results.description: The Water and Power Development Authority (WAPDA) has signed the agreement for HM-1 Contract of Diamer Basha Dam Project at a ceremony held at WAPDA House.

results.title: Israel’s Oct. 27 Election Highlights Divisions Over Palestinian Statehood
results.description: Netanyahu and several other leaders oppose statehood or say it is not feasible soon, while Ra’am chairman Mansour Abbas is urging Israel and the United States to recognize a Palestinian state.
